name: Rising Causeway V2 · Difficulty 1 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Raise the red bridge, set the yellow stair high toward the far ledge, and prime the blue spring. Drive onto it, then aim and release into the moving delivery bay. The spring adds forward and sideways momentum; wheels cannot steer in air. Dotted tracks show recent motion and the separate chart rows announce six seconds of spring position, bay centre at x = 28, and crosswind acceleration, with labelled physical scales.
